{{Quote|I assure you, sir, that this bomb only works on droids.|Sionver Boll|<ref name="TZB" />}}
The '''electro-proton bomb''' was an ion weapon developed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], specifically designed to destroy [[Droid/Legends|droids]].

==History==
[[File:Electro-proton_explosion.png|thumb|left|258x258px|The ion pulse created by the bomb on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]]]
Developed by the scientists of the Republic, the electro-proton bomb basically served as a gigantic [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|EMP grenade]]. It was designed to be deployed onto the battlefield by [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]], and once dropped, it would release a powerful [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]] shock wave capable of disabling or destroying any form of droid and vehicle within the expansive blast radius.<ref name="TZB" />
[[File:Electro-proton_bomb_effect.jpg|right|thumb|The effect of the bomb on droids|312x312px]]

[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] authorized the use of the electro-proton bomb on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] deployed a large [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|invasion force]] on the planet in order to secure its fuel reserves. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sionver Boll/Legends|Sionver Boll]] assured those present that the weapon would only affect droids, and that the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and other organic beings would not be harmed by its use. The native [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]] agreed to the decision in order to defeat the massive army of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] that had invaded their homeworld. Although the bomb was successful in defeating the Separatist threat, the [[Doge/Legends|Doge]] [[Nakha Urus/Legends|Nakha Urus]] had some fears that the bomb might have had a serious effect on the delicate balance of Malastare's ecosystem. Indeed, following the use of the bomb, the last of the [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beasts]] awakened from its slumber deep beneath the planet's surface and began attacking clone troopers and Dugs alike.<ref name="TZB" />

==Behind the scenes==
On the bomb, several phrases like "CAUTION ION DETONATOR" and "THIS IS FOR YOU DOOKU" are written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]].<ref name="EG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode218.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Zillo Beast}}</ref>
